name: Sendblue
description: iMessage, SMS, MMS and RCS API for AI agents and businesses: dedicated or shared phone lines, webhooks, FaceTime calls, a setup CLI and an official MCP server. Backed by Y Combinator.

skills.name: Send and Receive iMessages
skills.description: Send iMessage, SMS, MMS and RCS from a Sendblue number and receive inbound messages as webhook POSTs to your agent.

skills.name: Provision a Phone Number
skills.description: Get a shared sandbox line in minutes from the CLI, or provision dedicated inbound-first AI Agent lines via the API.

skills.name: Send Reactions and Typing
skills.description: Show typing indicators, send tapback reactions, read receipts, inline replies, voice notes and expressive effects.

skills.name: Check iMessage Support
skills.description: Look up whether a phone number can receive iMessage before sending, and fall back to SMS when it can't.

skills.name: Start FaceTime Calls
skills.description: Start programmatic FaceTime calls from a Sendblue line, or place PSTN voice calls through the Twilio integration.
